LogicLink Challenge

Complete the circuit! The final output bulb (Q) must light up (output 1). Toggle the AND and OR gates ON or OFF to solve the puzzle.

Digital Logic Basics

AND Gate: Outputs 1 only if ALL its inputs are 1.

OR Gate: Outputs 1 if AT LEAST ONE of its inputs is 1.

NOT Gate: Inverts its single input. 1 becomes 0, and 0 becomes 1.
